title: IoSP PHER Schema
description: PHER — Permissible Human Entry Request. Perimeter defense layer for the Internet of Sports Protocol. PHER is one gate with two doors: DIGITAL (pher_check) classifies, analyzes, and gates all inbound API requests before NEPH step 0. PHYSICAL (pher_scan) detects, classifies, and enforces policy against unauthorized hardware and transceivers inside sovereign physical spaces — facilities, clubs, training grounds. Both doors serve the same sovereignty: entities control who accesses their data and what devices operate in their space. Autonomous unbound agents are rejected digitally. Unauthorized transceivers are flagged physically. Etymology: Greek 'pherein' — to carry, to bear. You must bear proof of human backing to enter digitally. You must bear declared, authorized hardware to enter physically.

pher_id.description: Unique identifier for this PHER instance

protocol_floor.description: Protocol-level minimum enforcement. The floor. Entities can raise the bar but NEVER lower it below these minimums. This is not configurable. This is law. Applies to BOTH digital and physical perimeters.

minimum_requestor_class.description: Protocol minimum: requests must be at least human_supervised_agent class. Entities can require stricter (human_direct) but cannot allow looser (autonomous_agent). The floor.

autonomous_agent_policy.description: Protocol-level: autonomous unbound agents are ALWAYS rejected. This is NOT configurable by entities. Not by agents. Not by anyone. Maltys don't get in.

unknown_requestor_policy.description: Unknown requestors get challenged by default. Entities can override to reject.

behavioral_analysis_enabled.description: Always on at protocol level. Cannot be disabled. The sea monster never sleeps.

pher_required_for_neph.description: NEPH step 0 WILL NOT accept requests without a valid pher_pass_token. Non-negotiable.

threat_registry_participation.description: All PHER instances contribute anonymized threat data to the protocol-wide threat registry. Collective immunity is not optional.

physical_scan_enabled_for_facilities.description: Any IoSP entity of type 'facility' MUST have pher_scan capability defined. Physical perimeter is not optional for physical spaces. Implementation timeline may vary but the schema must be present from day one.

unauthorized_transceiver_policy.description: Protocol minimum for unauthorized transceivers detected in sovereign space. Entities can escalate but cannot ignore.

requestor_classification.description: DIGITAL DOOR. Every inbound API request is classified before any processing. Classification determines whether the request proceeds to NEPH or gets rejected/challenged.

requestor_id.description: Opaque identifier derived from connection metadata. PHER never trusts self-identification.

classification.description: human_direct: human at device. human_supervised_agent: IoSP agent with verified human oversight. autonomous_agent: ALWAYS REJECTED. unknown: challenged or rejected per policy.

liveness_attestation.description: Proof that a human is actively in the loop. Liveness can also be established via physical presence — a registered device detected by pher_scan can serve as supporting evidence.

attestation_type.description: physical_presence: entity's registered device detected by pher_scan in a sovereign facility. Supports but does not replace other types for high-security operations.

challenge_nonce.description: Single-use, time-bounded nonce for challenge_response type.

response_latency_ms.description: Instant (<200ms) flags bot behavior. Human baseline: 500ms-5000ms.

physical_presence_ref.description: For physical_presence type: reference to pher_scan device_detection record.

physical_presence_ttl_minutes.description: Very short — must be refreshed by ongoing pher_scan detection. Device leaves zone, presence expires in 5 minutes.

behavioral_fingerprint.description: DIGITAL DOOR. 8-dimension bot detection. Humans are messy. Bots are clockwork. PHER weaponizes human messiness. Feeds Omega risk and Gamma calibration.

coordination_signal.description: Bot swarms move in sync. Weight: 0.10

linguistic_entropy.description: LLM text has distinct signatures. Weight: 0.10

rf_zone.description: PHYSICAL DOOR. Defines a sovereign physical space where pher_scan operates. The physical equivalent of the digital perimeter. Every IoSP facility entity can define one or more RF zones. Zones can be nested (building > floor > room).

zone_name.description: E.g., 'Main Training Facility', 'Recovery Wing', 'Pool Deck', 'Weight Room'

zone_type.description: Different zone types may have different default hardware policies. Medical and restricted areas have stricter enforcement.

device_classification.description: PHYSICAL DOOR. Classification of a device detected by pher_scan. Parallel to requestor_classification on the digital side. Answers: WHAT hardware is this and is it authorized?

device_identifier_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of broadcast identifier. Raw identifiers never stored.

classification.description: authorized_entity_device: registered to IoSP entity. authorized_facility_infrastructure: facility hardware. declared_guest_device: declared at check-in. known_benign_environmental: neighboring WiFi, not a threat. unauthorized_transceiver: not declared/registered — potential harvester. suspected_harvester: actively collecting data. unknown_device: cannot classify.

device_type_inference.description: bci_neural_interface covers Neuralink and similar. recording_device covers hidden cameras/mics. bluetooth_relay and wifi_sniffer are active collection hardware.

is_actively_scanning.description: Scanning for other devices? Normal for phones. Suspicious for unknown hardware.

connection_attempts_observed.description: High count from unauthorized device = suspected harvester.

data_transmission_volume_bytes.description: High outbound from unauthorized device = active exfiltration.

is_promiscuous_mode.description: Listening to all traffic? Strong harvesting indicator.

entity_binding.description: If authorized_entity_device, the owning IoSP entity.

hardware_policy.description: PHYSICAL DOOR. Per-facility or per-zone policy governing what hardware is permitted. Physical equivalent of digital sovereignty_preferences.

bci_neural_interfaces.description: BCIs can harvest biometric and neural data from wearer AND nearby individuals via environmental sensors.

bci_specific_policy.description: Detailed BCI policy. BCIs are physically attached/implanted, potentially always-on, and can harvest neural, biometric, and environmental data.

data_transmission_monitoring.description: Monitor BCI outbound data while in facility.

local_storage_only_while_in_facility.description: Request BCI operate local-only (no cloud upload) in facility.

shielded_zones_available.description: Facility provides RF-shielded zones where BCI transmission is physically blocked.

third_party_data_sharing_prohibited.description: BCI manufacturer prohibited from accessing data collected in facility.

enforcement_level.description: advisory: detect and log. active_monitoring: detect, log, notify. active_response: detect, log, notify, automated action.

updated_by.description: MUST be facility entity (human_direct). Hardware policies are sovereign decisions.

pher_scan.description: PHYSICAL DOOR. The physical perimeter scan. Parallel to pher_check. A point-in-time sweep of an RF zone that detects, classifies, and evaluates all broadcasting devices. Flow: pher_scan detects -> device_classification classifies -> hardware_policy evaluates -> verdict per device.

zone_status.description: clear: all authorized. advisory: minor anomalies. alert: unauthorized detected. critical: active harvesting or attack.

scan_incident.description: PHYSICAL DOOR. Logged when pher_scan detects unauthorized hardware or policy violations. Parallel to pher_incident digital types. Physical signatures feed the protocol-wide threat registry.

affected_entities.description: IoSP entities whose data may have been at risk.

sovereignty_preferences.description: Per-entity PHER configuration governing BOTH digital and physical perimeters. Protocol floor always enforced. Entities raise the bar, never lower it. Can ONLY be modified by the entity via human_direct. 'Abidance is never required' applies to FEATURES. Security is the foundation.

origin_type.description: Digital API origin or physical hardware device

accept_physical_presence_as_liveness.description: Bridges physical door to digital door.

physical_perimeter_policy.description: PHYSICAL DOOR preferences. For facilities: configures pher_scan. For non-facilities (athletes, teams): declares preferences for how facilities should protect them.

bci_disclosure.description: Entity's BCI status. Voluntary but encouraged for accurate pher_scan classification.

updated_by.description: MUST be entity_iosp_address classified as human_direct. Sovereignty is sovereign.

pher_challenge.description: DIGITAL DOOR. Challenge issued when classification is uncertain or behavioral risk is elevated.

pher_check.description: DIGITAL DOOR. The digital perimeter check. Every API request passes through pher_check BEFORE NEPH step 0. Flow: pher_check -> pher_pass_token -> NEPH step 0.

pher_pass_token.description: Bridge between PHER and NEPH. Single-use, short-lived, cryptographically signed. No token = NEPH refuses.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature from PHER. NEPH verifies.

quarantine_record.description: DIGITAL DOOR. Requests held for entity review. Entity (human_direct ONLY) approves or rejects.

pher_incident.description: Logged when PHER rejects (digital) or detects unauthorized hardware (physical). Covers BOTH doors. Feeds threat registry.

threat_registry_entry.description: Protocol-wide shared threat intelligence. BOTH digital and physical signatures. One facility's detection protects all. Collective immunity across both doors.

pher_neph_bridge.description: Integration contract between PHER and NEPH.

physical_presence_confirmed.description: Bridges physical door evidence to digital door processing.

pher_omega_feed.description: Optional feed from PHER to Omega. BOTH digital and physical security data inform risk projections. Opt-in.

pher_gamma_integration.description: Gamma calibration tunes PHER behavioral score_weights. Detect -> calibrate -> improve.

pher_alpha_consideration.description: Read-only. PHER enforces Alpha ceiling limits at perimeter if entity opted in.
